description: This file is a shell script designed to reset and restore gateway settings by configuring system parameters, updating configuration files, and executing related scripts. It sets various system variables, modifies configuration files, and performs cleanup tasks like removing specific files and resetting database values. The script appears to be part of a device management or recovery process intended for network gateways or similar embedded systems.

methods.name: _update_db_value
methods.description: A helper function that updates specific key-value pairs in the system configuration database file at /nvram/syscfg.db, setting certain values to 0.
